sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The gameplay mechanics of The Rake Jigsaw puzzle are refreshingly straightforward. Players are presented with a grid of tiles, each with a piece of the larger picture. The objective is simple: slide the tiles into their correct positions to complete the puzzle.

The game features a 'drag and drop' mechanic, allowing players to move tiles around the grid by clicking and dragging them. This mechanic is incredibly intuitive, making it easy for players to navigate the grid and manipulate the tiles.

As players progress through the game, they will encounter various obstacles, such as locked tiles, special power tiles, and even a 'wildcard' tile that can be used to replace any other tile in the grid. These features add a welcome layer of complexity to the game, requiring players to think strategically and plan their moves carefully.

The game also features a 'move counter' that tracks the number of moves made by the player. This feature is both a blessing and a curse, as it adds an extra layer of challenge to the game while also providing a sense of accomplishment and satisfaction when completing puzzles quickly.

As you progress through The Rake Jigsaw puzzle, you'll encounter more complex puzzles that require advanced strategies and techniques. Here are a few tips to help you overcome these challenges:

Another advanced technique is to use the 'lock and key' method, which involves locking two tiles together to create a 'lock' that can be used to move other tiles.
